# forMaps Build Log — Foundation Checkpoint

## What was built (Phase 3 — Foundation slice)

### Generated by Printing Press
- Internal YAML spec at `research/formaps-spec.yaml`: 1 resource (lookup), 1 endpoint (gps_to_cadastral → AdE ajax), 1 type (AjaxLookupResult).
- Standard scaffold: client, store (SQLite), config, doctor, sync, MCP server (cobratree-walked), agent-context, profile, feedback, workflow framework.
- All 8 generation quality gates passed (go mod tidy / govulncheck / vet / build / binary build / --help / version / doctor).

### Hand-authored novel commands
- `internal/cli/gps.go` — positional `<lon> <lat>` wrapper around the AdE endpoint. Italy bbox guard. `--strict` mode. Reuses the typed client.
- `internal/cli/gps_stream.go` — `--stdin` streaming mode for batch reverse-geocoding. CSV-compatible input, JSONL output with input echo per row.
- `internal/cli/cadastral.go` — reverse lookup via ondata Parquet. `mcp:read-only`. Validates codice belfiore syntax. Foglio/particella numeric-form normalization (`2` ↔ `0002`).
- `internal/cli/validate.go` — parse-only syntax check. Returns JSON report + typed exit code (2) on invalid input.
- `internal/ondata/ondata.go` — pure-Go Parquet client using `github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go`. Caches `index.parquet` and per-region files under the OS user-cache dir. Maps to `ParcelResult` with WGS84 conversion (int microdegrees / 1e6).

### Wired into root.go
Three new top-level commands registered: `gps`, `cadastral`, `validate`. Existing `lookup` (spec-derived) retained.

## What's deferred for the next checkpoint

From the absorb manifest's 7 novel features, 3 are built (`gps`, `cadastral`, `validate`). The remaining 4 — `neighbours`, `around`, `coverage`, `drift`, plus `search` (FTS over local cache) — are deferred per the user's "foundation first" choice. They depend on a richer local cache: full Parquet → SQLite sync, FTS5 over comuni/parcels, and AdE WFS integration for adjacency / polygon retrieval.

|---|---|---|

| `gps --stdin` (3 rows) | Roma + Milano + Amsterdam | ✓ Roma parcel, Milano STRADA, Amsterdam bbox-rejected |
| `validate --comune H501 ...` | valid | ✓ `valid:true` |
| `validate --comune ROMA --foglio abc` | invalid | ✓ Errors listed, exit 2 |
| `cadastral --comune M011 --foglio 2 --particella 2` | ondata README example | ✓ lat=37.639896 lon=14.181642 (exact match) |

- `printing-press scorecard` — 80/100 Grade A.
- Gaps: `mcp_token_efficiency` 4/10, `workflows` 4/10, `insight` 2/10 — all directly addressable by building the deferred novel features. No structural gaps.

## Limitations + known gaps

- Trentino-Alto-Adige (TN, BZ) returns `ErrComuneNotIndexed` — AdE has no public data for TAA.
- `--sezione` on `cadastral` is currently echoed but not used to match (ondata Parquet doesn't carry sezione directly). Resolving correctly requires the `sezione`-aware shape from the Parquet — needs investigation.
- AdE ajax endpoint returns `TIPOLOGIA: STRADA` for points on streets (not on a parcel). Currently passed through verbatim; the CLI does not normalize this into an error shape.
- `lookup` (auto-generated) and `gps` (hand-written) both call the same endpoint — `lookup` is for parity with the spec; `gps` is the human/agent-facing surface.
